settings.reply_address_help: Dedicated mailbox that receives replies. Must accept any +alias under the same local part. Example: inbox@reply.example.com.
settings.secret_help: Signs reply aliases so they cannot be forged. Leave blank to auto-generate on first use; the stored value is encrypted. Do NOT change after notifications are out — old aliases become invalid.
settings.require_sender_match_label: Only accept replies sent from the confirmed email address of the account
settings.require_sender_match_help: Rejects replies whose From address does not match the confirmed email of the user the alias was issued to. Disable only if users reply through forwarding addresses.
settings.max_replies_per_hour_label: Maximum replies per user per hour
settings.max_replies_per_hour_help: Replies above this limit are rejected. 0 = unlimited.
settings.send_rejection_notices_label: Email the author when a reply cannot be posted
settings.send_rejection_notices_help: Sent only to the account's confirmed address, at most once per day per reason (no permission, discussion unavailable or private, hourly limit, empty or too long).
settings.show_badge_help: Display a small badge next to posts that were created from an inbound email reply.
settings.webhook_secret_help: Required header X-Mail-Reply-Token in POST /api/mail-reply/inbound. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32
settings.providers_help: Configure the provider to POST directly to the endpoint — no script.
settings.mailgun_signing_key_help: When set, Mailgun requests are authenticated by their signature instead of the X-Mail-Reply-Token header. Stored encrypted.
settings.providers_mailgun_step4: Save the HTTP webhook signing key below (Mailgun → Sending → Webhooks). Routes cannot send custom headers, so requests are authenticated by the Mailgun signature instead of X-Mail-Reply-Token.
settings.providers_postmark_step4: Postmark sends JSON with ToFull/TextBody — the endpoint accepts it natively.
settings.providers_cloudflare_summary: How to use Cloudflare Email Routing
settings.providers_cf_step1: Cloudflare → Email → Email Routing → Email Workers
settings.providers_cf_step2: The Worker receives a ForwardableEmailMessage and calls fetch() on
settings.providers_cf_step4: Use message.raw as the body. Content-Type: message/rfc822.
settings.copy_failed: Could not copy to the clipboard. Select the text and copy it manually.
settings.webhook_script_help: Install it on the mail server (not on Flarum) and pipe the reply alias to it — an alternative to a provider.
settings.imap_host_help: Server to poll for replies. Requires webklex/php-imap.
settings.imap_port_help: Typically 993 for SSL/TLS, 143 for STARTTLS or plain.
settings.imap_password_help: App-password recommended (Gmail, Microsoft 365). Stored encrypted; type a new password to replace it.
settings.imap_delete_after_help: When disabled, messages are only flagged as Seen — useful while testing.
settings.imap_validate_cert_help: Keep enabled in production; disable only when testing with a self-signed cert.
settings.imap_test_help: Checks that Flarum can connect with the values above.
settings.imap_test_ok: ✓ IMAP connection succeeded — {mailbox}: {unseen} unread; capture pattern: {pattern}
settings.imap_test_error_missing_dependency: ✗ The webklex/php-imap package is not installed. Run: composer require webklex/php-imap
settings.imap_test_error_mailbox_not_found: ✗ Folder {mailbox} was not found on the server.
settings.imap_test_error_request: ✗ The IMAP test request failed. Check the server logs.
settings.webhook_install_step3_note: DirectAdmin rejects pipe destinations ("invalid email address") unless the server admin sets allow_forwarder_pipe=1 in directadmin.conf. Its PHP binary is usually /usr/local/bin/php — confirm with which php.
settings.webhook_install_step3_cpanel: On cPanel: Forwarders → Add Forwarder → Advanced Options → Pipe to a Program, with the same command.
settings.mode_imap_detail: The mailbox is polled every minute: inside queue:work when a real queue driver (redis, database…) is configured, otherwise by the Flarum scheduler — add a cron entry running php flarum schedule:run every minute. /api/mail-reply/inbound returns 404.
settings.mode_webhook_detail: POST to /api/mail-reply/inbound with the X-Mail-Reply-Token header; accepted messages get HTTP 202 and are processed in the background. The IMAP poller is paused.
settings.mode_disabled_detail: Reply by email is off: notifications go out normally, without a reply address, and nothing is fetched or accepted.
settings.polling_loop_down: An async queue is configured but no polling loop is alive — make sure php flarum queue:work is running.
settings.polling_scheduler: Polling through the Flarum scheduler — needs a cron entry running php flarum schedule:run every minute.
settings.polling_disabled: No replies are fetched or accepted.
settings.status_error: Could not load the inbound status.
settings.alias_pending: Type the reply mailbox above to preview your real Reply-To.
settings.feed_empty: No inbound email yet. Replies will appear here as they arrive.
settings.feed_empty_filter: None of the latest messages has this status.
settings.reason_invalid_address: Alias missing, malformed or with an invalid signature
settings.reason_unknown_user: The alias points to a user that no longer exists
settings.reason_sender_mismatch: Sent from an address other than the account email
settings.reason_discussion_unavailable: Discussion deleted or no longer visible to the user
settings.reason_not_allowed: User may no longer reply to the discussion
settings.reason_empty_body: No new text above the quoted message
settings.reason_too_long: Longer than the maximum post length
settings.reason_system_sender: Sent by a system address (mailer-daemon, noreply…)
settings.imap_test_needs_fields: Fill in the IMAP host, username and password to test the connection.
settings.webhook_script_needs_secret: Set or generate the webhook secret to get a ready-to-use script.
settings.webhook_install_step1: SSH into the mail server and paste the script into
settings.webhook_install_step4: Test with a mention. Watch <log>/var/log/exim/mainlog</log> and expect <expect>T=virtual_address_pipe ... Completed</expect>.

rejected.subject: [{forum}] Your reply by email was not posted
rejected.body: Hi {username}, the reply you sent by email to {forum} could not be posted.
rejected.reason_not_allowed: You no longer have permission to reply to that discussion (it may have been locked).
rejected.reason_discussion_unavailable: The discussion no longer exists or is no longer visible to you.
rejected.reason_private_discussion: Replies by email are only accepted on public discussions.
rejected.reason_rate_limited: You reached the hourly limit of replies by email. Please wait a while or reply on the forum.
rejected.reason_empty_body: We could not find any new text above the quoted message.
rejected.reason_too_long: The reply is longer than the maximum post length.
rejected.footer: Original subject: {subject}. You can reply directly on the forum.
